questions.question: When I search for an owner by surname, what happens with zero, one, or many matches?
questions.answerNote: OwnerController.processFindForm: blank last name = all owners; findByLastNameStartingWith with page size 5; none -> field error "not found" on the find form; exactly one -> redirect to /owners/{id}; many -> paginated ownersList.

questions.question: What rules must a pet's details satisfy before it can be saved?
questions.answerNote: PetValidator: name required and at most 30 characters, type required for new pets, birth date required (PetController also rejects duplicate names and future birth dates).

questions.question: Is the list of veterinarians cached, and where is that set up?
questions.answerNote: VetRepository findAll methods are @Cacheable("vets"); CacheConfiguration (@EnableCaching) creates the "vets" JCache cache with statistics enabled.

questions.question: How do I run the app against MySQL instead of the built-in in-memory database?
questions.answerNote: Default is H2 (application.properties database=h2); activate spring.profiles.active=mysql so application-mysql.properties sets MYSQL_URL/USER/PASS and db/mysql schema+data; README shows docker run / docker compose up mysql.

questions.question: How can a visitor switch the site's language?
questions.answerNote: WebConfiguration registers a SessionLocaleResolver (default English) and a LocaleChangeInterceptor on the "lang" URL parameter (?lang=de); texts come from messages/messages*.properties (spring.messages.basename).

questions.question: Is there a page that deliberately triggers an error to show what the error screen looks like?
questions.answerNote: CrashController GET /oups throws a RuntimeException on purpose; Spring Boot renders templates/error.html with status-specific message.

questions.question: Where are the database tables and the sample owners, pets and vets defined?
questions.answerNote: src/main/resources/db/<database>/schema.sql + data.sql (h2 default; mysql and postgres variants), loaded via spring.sql.init.*-locations using ${database}; JPA ddl-auto is none.

questions.question: When booking a vet visit for a pet, what stops someone choosing a date in the past?
questions.answerNote: VisitController: loadPetWithVisit resolves owner+pet from the path; minVisitDate model attribute = today+1 for the form; processNewVisitForm rejects a date not after today (typeMismatch.visitDate), otherwise adds the visit and saves the owner.
